resolved_validation_issues: Initial short ambient fixtures ended before the first sensor sample. Backend fixtures now explicitly sample every 10 ms; browser fixtures run long enough. All campaign members must have nonempty networks.
A lease test expected a failed run, but the established contract blocks the run and fails its job; assertion corrected.
Test worker capabilities are initialized at first poll, and AI prepare returns sources inside evidence; fixtures corrected.
Browser selectors and modal assertions corrected; graphical JSON link placement and responsive layout improved after screenshot review.
limits: Directed selection only. Shared and independent ecological habitats, resource/reproduction strategies and editable worlds are separate pending work.
All evaluation copies are isolated; only pre-evaluation candidates are inherited. Final verification never feeds back into selection.
Different seeds are not proof of independent samples. Reused evaluation environments, shared ancestors and censored survival are declared.
No structural crossover, implicit rewiring, parameter mutation or default consciousness fitness score.
ZIP contains complete campaign-level evidence and provenance, not every individual model, raw stimulus or trajectory. Those have separate per-run exports.
The 2 GiB uncompressed export limit fails atomically rather than reporting silent truncation. Streaming/spooled output is not a throughput capacity claim.
No real external AI requests, old data migration or new Docker image verification were performed in this phase.
